Face Landmarker model bundle, float16 version1
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
Model components: BlazeFace short-range, FaceMesh-V2 and BlendshapeV2.
The official model cards state Apache License, Version2.0:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/MediaPipe%20BlazeFace%20Model%20Card%20(Short%20Range).pdf
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20MediaPipe%20Face%20Mesh%20V2.pdf
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20Blendshape%20V2.pdf
The model is redistributed unmodified. MediaPipe is a trademark of Google.

The runtime's upstream privacy notice mentions API metrics reporting.
GHPhotoEdit hosts assets locally and restricts face-engine scripts/connections to
its own origin via Content Security Policy. The Android WebView blocks external
HTTP(S) resource requests; its appassets.androidplatform.net endpoint is intercepted
and served from bundled assets. Test request logs showed only these local resources.
No photos or face landmarks are sent to Google by GHPhotoEdit.
